name: tokenrx
description: TokenRx: shows your usage limits, this chat's size and the minutes left on its prompt cache above the prompt, keeps a long chat's cache warm while you are away (or warns, or compacts) before it cools, and tidies the desktop chat list (/tokenrx:tidy).

lang.title: Language
lang.description: auto follows TOKENRX_LANG, then the system language

autoCompact.title: Auto compact
autoCompact.description: on: compact a chat of 100K+ tokens automatically 5 minutes before its cache cools; off: only warn

keepAlive.title: Keep alive
keepAlive.description: Keep a 100K+ token chat's cache warm while you are away: 5 minutes before it cools, send a one-line nudge (about 1/40 of re-saving it), for up to this long after your last message; then compact (if on) or warn. Subscription accounts only; the PC and the app must stay on.
